name: house-style
description: Claude-only package. The portable core is empty of runtime behaviour by design: no scripts, no skills, and no executable. Two reference documents sit at the package root as text other packages copy. The behaviour Claude Code loads is the output style under com.infiquetra.claude/, declared by the outputStyles key because that key replaces the default output-styles/ directory.
